01

Five articles contain a placeholder phone number

Six blocks across five articles use (704) 555-0123, and one visibly lists a placeholder address instead of the Charlotte office.

  • Replace the six mapped 555 numbers with the approved 704-547-8555 contact pattern, keeping normal phone tracking.
  • Change the UnitedHealthcare article address to 8401 University Executive Park Dr Suite 118, Charlotte NC 28262.

02

Offscreen videos add work to the first load

The hero background is discovered late through CSS, while two belowfold YouTube players load roughly 486 KB each before visitors reach them.

  • Preload the exact active hero-bg.webp with high priority; keep the existing 10 KB image and critical first-screen styles.
  • Lazy-initialize #video-6-6583 and #video-7-6583, preserving both approved videos; retest loading without removing tracking.
03

Schema has unusable offers and outdated business fields

Treatment Product blocks contain invalid offer/review data, while business fields use missing logos, wrong pins and 4 PM Wednesday closing.

  • Remove the 37 treatment Product blocks and correct or suppress the two literal placeholder FAQ blocks; keep valid Service and business schema.
  • Use the current April logo, approved pin 35.3033179,-80.7543197 and Wednesday closing 15:00 in the mapped business records.
04

Older blog listings point search to page one

Fourteen distinct article-listing pages, /blog/page/2/ through /15/, incorrectly canonicalize to /blog/.

  • Give each numbered listing its own canonical URL while keeping its different article cards.
  • Keep the working pagination links and page-one redirect; do not merge or delete the older articles.

05

The thank-you page is indexable

/thank-you/ confirms an already received request but is index,follow and included in the XML sitemap.

  • Set only /thank-you/ to noindex,follow and remove it from XML.
  • Keep the confirmation URL, form redirect and conversion tracking working.

Fix order

Correct article contact details, complete the narrow schema and indexing changes, then improve first-load discovery.

  • Website: six article blocks, mapped schema fields, archive canonicals, confirmation robots and scoped media loading.
  • SEO: verify after deployment and refresh mature performance data; no broad new menu, content or GBP-post campaign.

Keep approved videos, images, tracking and provider changes. Mobile origin LCP is good; lab timing is different and keyword volumes are unavailable.
